title: RULES AND REGULATIONS ON THE ADMISSION, MOVEMENT AND WITHDRAWAL OF GOODS IN FREE ZONES
subject: Admission, movement and withdrawal of Goods in Free Zones
date_issued: JUL 23 2019 (approved by the Secretary of Finance on AUG 08 2019)
effectivity: Thirty (30) days from publication at the Official Gazette or a newspaper of national circulation

CAO 1-2019 Post Clearance Audit and Prior Disclosure Program

ai.title: CAO 11-2019: Admission, Movement at Withdrawal ng Goods sa Free Zones
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ito ang implementing rules ng Sections 814–817 (Chapter 3, Title VIII) at Section 1003 (c) ng CMTA para sa Goods na pumapasok sa Free Zones, lumalabas papunta sa Customs Territory, at lumilipat mula isang Free Zone papunta sa isa pa.

🔍 Breakdown: Intro at Secs. 1–2: legal basis, saklaw at layunin. Sec. 3: depinisyon (Admission, Free Zone, Locator, Port User, Transit, atbp.). Sec. 4: 4.1 exemption sa duty at tax; 4.2 Admission; 4.3 Movement (within zone at zone-to-zone); 4.4 Withdrawal for consumption; 4.5 coordination sa Free Zone Authority; 4.6 record-keeping (3 taon); 4.7 Free Zones Monitoring Office. Sec. 5: Joint Administrative Orders. Sec. 6: Data Management. Secs. 8–11: periodic review, separability, transitory provision, effectivity. Sa dulo: Informational Section (History, Related Policies, References).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isipin mo ang Free Zone bilang special area na hindi basta sakop ng duty at tax. Pero kapag lumabas ang goods papunta sa mainland (Customs Territory) para gamitin o ibenta doon, kailangan ng Goods Declaration for Consumption at bayad ng duties at taxes. Ang CAO na ito ang nagsasabi kung paano ang papeles at kontrol sa buong proseso.

📦 Halimbawa: Isang Locator sa Free Zone ang nag-import ng machine parts. Pagpasok, naka-lodge ang Goods Declaration for Admission sa Bureau at sa Free Zone Authority. Kalaunan, may bumili mula sa labas ng zone (domestic sale): maglo-lodge ng Goods Declaration for Consumption, ilalakip ang copy ng naunang Declaration for Admission, at babayaran ang duties at taxes (kasama ang VAT) bago ma-release ang goods.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Dito nakasalalay ang kontrol para hindi makalusot ang goods mula Free Zone papunta Customs Territory nang walang tamang duties at taxes, at para may timely at accurate na data ang BOC sa admitted Goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Duty rate at exchange rate sa time of withdrawal ang ia-apply (4.4.3). 3 taon ang record keeping (4.6.1). Magkaiba ang Locator at Port User, kaya magkaiba ang Goods Declaration sa direct admission (4.2.3). Sa printed text, walang Section 7: mula Sec. 6 diretso sa Sec. 8.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Tandaan ang tatlong Goods Declaration: for Admission (Locator, direct), for Consumption (Port User at withdrawal papuntang Customs Territory), at for Transit (dumaan sa Customs Territory papuntang Free Zone). Tandaan din ang 3-year record keeping at ang 30 days from publication na effectivity.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Exempted ba sa duty at tax ang lahat ng goods sa Free Zone? Sagot: Hindi absolute. 'Unless otherwise provided by law' at ayon sa laws ng Free Zone authorities (Sec. 4.1), at kapag withdrawn into the Customs Territory, babayaran ang duties at taxes bago ma-release (Sec. 4.4.4).

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Secs. 814–817 at 1003 (c); RA 7916 (PEZA); RA 7227 (Bases Conversion and Development Act); CAO 1-2019 (Post Clearance Audit); Goods Declaration for Transit; ATRIG.

paragraphs.text: This CAO implements Sections 814 to 817, Chapter 3, Title VIII; Section 1003 (c) and other related provisions of Republic Act No. 10863, otherwise known as the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA) in relation to pertinent laws and regulations governing Free Zones.

ai.title: Legal Basis ng CAO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sinasabi dito kung saang batas nakabase ang CAO: Sections 814–817 (Chapter 3, Title VIII) at Section 1003 (c) ng CMTA o RA 10863, kaugnay ng mga batas na sumasaklaw sa Free Zones.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'pinanggagalingan ng authority' ng BOC para gumawa ng rules sa Free Zone goods. Parang manual ito kung paano i-apply ang CMTA sa Free Zones.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Gumagana ito 'in relation to' ang mga batas ng Free Zones, kaya laging basahin kasabay ng mga iyon.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Introduction ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Legal Basis ng CAO. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: This CAO shall be applicable to Goods admitted into Free Zones, withdrawn from Free Zones into Customs Territory and Goods transferred from one Free Zone to another Free Zone.

ai.title: Saklaw ng CAO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Tatlong sitwasyon ang sakop: Goods na ina-admit sa Free Zones, Goods na withdrawn mula Free Zone papunta Customs Territory, at Goods na inililipat mula isang Free Zone papunta sa isa pa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isipin mo ang 3 galaw: pasok sa zone, labas ng zone papuntang mainland, at lipat sa ibang zone.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang galaw sa loob ng iisang zone ay pangunahing responsibilidad ng Free Zone Authority na i-monitor (Sec. 4.3.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 1. Scope ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Saklaw ng CAO. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide the guidelines and institute safeguard measures to control and monitor the Admission, withdrawal and movement of Goods by Free Zones Locators.

ai.title: Objective: Control at Monitoring
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magbigay ng guidelines at safeguard measures para makontrol at ma-monitor ang Admission, withdrawal at movement ng Goods ng Free Zones Locators.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May sistema para masubaybayan ang goods ng locators; hindi ito basta-basta nakakagalaw nang walang bantay.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang focus ng objective na ito ay ang Goods ng Free Zones Locators.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Objective: Control at Monitoring. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To adopt clear and transparent customs rules, regulations, policies and procedures on Free Zones, consistent with international standards and Customs best practices.

ai.title: Objective: Transparent Customs Rules
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magpatibay ng malinaw at transparent na customs rules, regulations, policies at procedures sa Free Zones na consistent sa international standards at Customs best practices.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dapat predictable at naaayon sa international practice ang proseso.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May reference ito sa Section 101 (b) ng CMTA (Title I, Chapter 2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.2 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Objective: Transparent Customs Rules. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To generate timely and accurate information on admitted Goods into the Free Zone through the full use of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) enabled system.

ai.title: Objective: ICT-enabled Information
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Makakuha ng timely at accurate na impormasyon sa admitted Goods sa Free Zone gamit ang full use ng ICT-enabled system.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Computerized ang tracking para mabilis at tama ang data.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kaugnay ito ng Secs. 4.2.2 at 4.5.2 na nag-uutos ng ICT interfacing at BOC-Free Zone inter-operability.

paragraphs.text: To ensure proper collection of duties and taxes on withdrawal of Goods for consumption in the Customs Territory.

ai.title: Objective: Tamang Koleksyon ng Duties at Taxes
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Siguraduhing tama ang koleksyon ng duties at taxes kapag ang Goods ay withdrawn for consumption sa Customs Territory.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Exempt sa duty at tax ang goods habang nasa zone, pero kapag lumabas para gamitin sa mainland, dapat bayad.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang detalye ay nasa Sec. 4.4 (Withdrawal of Goods).

paragraphs.text: For purposes of this CAO, the following terms are defined accordingly:

ai.title: Definition of Terms
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula sa listahan ng mga depinisyon na gagamitin sa buong CAO.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang mga terms na ito ay may specific na kahulugan 'for purposes of this CAO' lang, kaya basahin nang eksakto ang wording.

paragraphs.text: Admission – shall refer to the act of bringing imported Goods directly or through Transit into a Free Zone.

ai.title: Definition: Admission
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang 'Admission' ay ang pagpasok ng imported Goods sa Free Zone — direkta o sa pamamagitan ng Transit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Direct = ang Freeport mismo ang port of discharge. Through Transit = dumaan muna sa customs control bago makarating sa Free Zone.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Huwag ihalo sa 'Entry' (3.3): Admission ay pagpasok sa Free Zone; Entry ay pagpasok sa Customs Territory.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.1 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Admission. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Territory – shall refer to areas in the Philippines where customs and tariff laws are enforced.

ai.title: Definition: Customs Territory
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Mga lugar sa Pilipinas kung saan ipinatutupad ang customs at tariff laws.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa context ng CAO na ito, ito ang katapat ng Free Zone — kapag pumasok dito ang goods, dapat sundin ang customs at tariff laws.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Importante ito sa Sec. 4.4: withdrawal 'into the Customs Territory'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.2 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Customs Territory. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Entry – shall refer to the act, documentation and process of bringing imported Goods into the Customs Territory, including Goods coming from Free Zones.

ai.title: Definition: Entry
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang act, documentation at process ng pagdadala ng imported Goods sa Customs Territory, kasama ang Goods na galing sa Free Zones.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag lumabas ang goods mula Free Zone papunta sa mainland, may 'Entry' na — kailangan ng Goods Declaration for Consumption.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama sa definition ang Goods na galing Free Zones, hindi lang galing abroad.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.3 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Entry. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Free Zone – shall refer to special economic zones registered with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) under Republic Act No. 7916, as amended, duly chartered or legislated special economic zones and freeports such as Clark Freeport Zone, Clark Special Economic Zone, Clark Green City; Poro Point Freeport Zone; John Hay Special Economic Zone and Subic Bay Freeport Zone under Republic Act No. 7227, as amended by Republic Act No. 9400; the Aurora Economic Zone and Freeport Authority under Republic Act No. 9490, as amended by Republic Act 10083; the Cagayan Special Economic Zone and Freeport under Republic Act No. 7922; the Zamboanga City Special Economic Zone Authority under Republic Act No. 7903; the Freeport Area of Bataan under Republic Act No. 9728, Morong Special Economic Zone under Proclamation 984 s. 1997; and such other freeports as established or may be created by law.

ai.title: Definition: Free Zone
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sakop ng 'Free Zone' ang PEZA-registered special economic zones, at ang mga chartered o legislated SEZs at freeports gaya ng Clark, Poro Point, John Hay, Subic, Aurora, Cagayan, Zamboanga, Bataan at Morong, pati ang ibang freeports na itinatag o itatatag ng batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Open-ended ang listahan: kapag may batas na nagtatag ng freeport, sakop din ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tandaan ang mga batas na binanggit: RA 7916, RA 7227 (as amended by RA 9400), RA 9490 (as amended by RA 10083), RA 7922, RA 7903, RA 9728 at Proclamation 984 s. 1997.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.4 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Free Zone. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Free Zone Locator – shall refer to a sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation or entity duly registered with the Free Zone Authorities and issued a Certificate of Registration and/or Tax Exemption that is not expired or has not been revoked, suspended or cancelled.

ai.title: Definition: Free Zone Locator
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation o entity na rehistrado sa Free Zone Authorities at may Certificate of Registration at/o Tax Exemption na hindi expired, revoked, suspended o cancelled.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'resident business' ng zone na valid pa ang registration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kapag expired, revoked, suspended o cancelled ang certificate, hindi na siya Locator ayon sa definition. Magkaiba ito sa Port User (3.11).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.5 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Free Zone Locator. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods – shall refer to articles, wares, merchandise and any other items which are subject of importation or exportation.

ai.title: Definition: Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Articles, wares, merchandise at iba pang items na subject ng importation o exportation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Halos lahat ng bagay na pwedeng i-import o i-export ay 'Goods'.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ayon sa footnote ng CAO, hango ito sa Section 102 (x) ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.6 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods Declaration – shall refer to a statement made in the manner prescribed by the Bureau and other appropriate agencies, by which the persons concerned indicate the procedure to be observed in the application for the Entry or Admission of imported Goods and the particulars of which the customs administration shall require.

ai.title: Definition: Goods Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Statement na ginawa sa paraang itinakda ng Bureau at ibang appropriate agencies, kung saan ipinapahiwatig ng concerned persons ang procedure sa application for Entry o Admission ng imported Goods at ang particulars na hinihingi ng customs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang main 'papel' ng shipment — dito idi-declare kung anong goods ang dala at anong proseso ang gagamitin (Admission, Consumption o Transit).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Iba-iba ang uri sa CAO na ito: for Admission, for Consumption, at for Transit (Sec. 4.2.3).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.7 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Goods Declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Importation – shall refer to the act of bringing in of Goods from a foreign territory into Philippine territory, whether for consumption, warehousing, or admission as defined in this CAO.

ai.title: Definition: Importation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagdadala ng Goods mula foreign territory papunta Philippine territory — para sa consumption, warehousing, o admission ayon sa definition ng CAO.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit para sa Free Zone lang ang goods, 'importation' pa rin ito basta galing abroad.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ang 'admission' bilang isa sa mga purposes, kaya counted ang Free Zone imports.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.8 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Importation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Lodgement – shall refer to the electronic registration of a Goods Declaration with the Free Zone Authority and the Bureau.

ai.title: Definition: Lodgement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Electronic registration ng Goods Declaration sa Free Zone Authority at sa Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 'Lodge' = i-register nang electronic; dalawang ahensya ang pinag-re-registran.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Single Lodgement ang goal ng Sec. 4.2.2.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.9 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Lodgement. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Multi-Purpose Declaration – shall refer to a customs single administrative document (SAD) accomplished by the importer, or his authorized representative, under oath and submitted to the Bureau for purposes of declaring and identifying among others the nature of the Goods being imported, its value, volume, weight, and any relevant description thereof, whether entered for consumption, Warehousing or by admission which will assist the Bureau in determining the true description of the Goods, the correct classification and the assessment of the duties and taxes due to the imported Goods, if any.

ai.title: Definition: Multi-Purpose Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Customs single administrative document (SAD) na ginawa ng importer o authorized representative, under oath, at isinumite sa Bureau para i-declare ang nature, value, volume, weight at description ng Goods — consumption, Warehousing o admission — para matukoy ang true description, tamang classification at duties and taxes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang form na pwedeng gamitin sa iba't ibang purpose ng import: consumption, warehousing o admission.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Under oath ito, kaya dapat accurate ang declaration. May reference sa Customs Administrative Order 1-2009.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.10 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Multi-Purpose Declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Port User – shall refer to a sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation or entity that is not a Free Zone Locator, as defined herein, who uses the seaport or airport facility of a Free Zone for customs clearance on their importation.

ai.title: Definition: Port User
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation o entity na hindi Free Zone Locator at gumagamit ng seaport o airport facility ng Free Zone para sa customs clearance ng importation nila.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi siya resident ng zone, pero doon dumadaan ang cargo niya dahil sa port ng Free Zone ito dumating.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Goods Declaration for Consumption ang gamit niya sa direct admission (Sec. 4.2.3.b).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.11 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Port User. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Single Administrative Document (SAD) – shall refer to an internationally accepted form as customs declaration or Goods Declaration, designed to standardize customs documents, harmonize codification and simplify procedures in international trade exchanges.

ai.title: Definition: Single Administrative Document (SAD)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Internationally accepted form bilang customs declaration o Goods Declaration, para i-standardize ang customs documents, i-harmonize ang codification at pasimplehin ang procedures sa international trade.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pare-parehong format ng customs declaration para mas madali ang proseso sa international trade.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang Multi-Purpose Declaration (3.10) ay isang uri ng SAD.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.12 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Single Administrative Document (SAD). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transit – shall refer to the customs procedure under which Goods, in its original form, are transported under customs control from one customs office to another, or to a Free Zone.

ai.title: Definition: Transit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Customs procedure kung saan ang Goods, sa original form, ay dinadala under customs control mula isang customs office papunta sa iba, o papunta sa Free Zone.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kontrolado ng customs ang goods habang bumibiyahe, hindi pa ito basta nai-release sa mainland.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'In its original form' ang goods sa Transit. Ang Goods na dumaan sa Customs Territory papunta sa Free Zone ay covered ng Goods Declaration for Transit (Sec. 4.2.3.c).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.13 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Transit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transit Permit – shall refer to a document authorizing the transfer of Goods from one Free Zone into another Free Zone in such form and guidelines as prescribed by the Bureau and the Zone Authorities.

ai.title: Definition: Transit Permit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dokumentong nag-a-authorize ng paglipat ng Goods mula isang Free Zone papunta sa isa pang Free Zone, sa form at guidelines na itinakda ng Bureau at Zone Authorities.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'permit' para sa zone-to-zone transfer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatanggapin ito bilang Goods Declaration for Transit and Admission (Sec. 4.3.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.14 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Definition: Transit Permit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Exemption from Duty and Tax of Goods in Free Zones. Unless otherwise provided by law and in accordance with the respective laws, rules and regulations of the Free Zone authorities, Goods admitted into a Free Zone shall not be subject to duty and tax.

ai.title: Exemption sa Duty at Tax
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Goods na ina-admit sa Free Zone ay hindi subject sa duty at tax, maliban kung may ibang probisyon ang batas at alinsunod sa mga batas, rules at regulations ng Free Zone authorities.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Habang nasa loob ng zone, hindi sinisingil ng duty at tax ang goods, pero hindi ito absolute.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Unless otherwise provided by law' — may exceptions. Kapag nilabas sa Customs Territory, may bayad (Sec. 4.4). Batayan: Sec. 815 ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.1 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Exemption sa Duty at Tax. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Admission of Goods into Free Zones.

ai.title: Admission of Goods into Free Zones
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ng mga rules sa pagpasok ng Goods sa Free Zone (Secs. 4.2.1 hanggang 4.2.3).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dito mo makikita kung paano at anong dokumento ang kailangan sa pagpasok ng goods sa zone.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.2 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Admission of Goods into Free Zones. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Imported Goods shall be admitted into a Free Zone when the Goods Declaration, together with all documents as may be required by existing laws and regulations, are electronically lodged with the Bureau and other relevant Free Zone Authorities at the time of Admission.

ai.title: Electronic Lodgement sa Admission
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang imported Goods ay ina-admit sa Free Zone kapag electronically lodged na ang Goods Declaration kasama ang lahat ng required documents sa Bureau at sa relevant Free Zone Authorities sa oras ng Admission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang admission kung hindi pa naka-lodge ang declaration at kumpleto ang dokumento.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawa ang tatanggap: Bureau at Free Zone Authority. Timing: 'at the time of Admission'. Batayan: Sec. 814 ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.2.1 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Electronic Lodgement sa Admission. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau and the Free Zone Authority shall ensure that their respective ICT systems are capable of interfacing to allow the single Lodgement of Goods Declaration for Admission with the Bureau and the Free Zone Authority.

ai.title: ICT Interfacing para sa Single Lodgement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat tiyakin ng Bureau at Free Zone Authority na compatible ang kanilang ICT systems para sa single Lodgement ng Goods Declaration for Admission sa dalawang ahensya.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang beses lang mag-lodge ang locator, pero makikita ito ng parehong ahensya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Responsibilidad ito ng Bureau at ng Free Zone Authority, hindi ng importer.

paragraphs.text: Goods transited through a Customs Territory and admitted into Free Zones shall be covered by a Goods Declaration for Transit which shall be accepted by the Bureau and Free Zone Authorities as Goods Declaration for Transit and Admission whenever appropriate.

paragraphs.text: Within the Zone. Free Zone Authorities shall have the responsibility to monitor the movement of Goods within the Free Zone where the Goods are admitted. The Free Zone Authorities shall provide the Bureau copies of the report for the purpose of monitoring the location of the admitted Goods.

ai.title: Movement sa Loob ng Zone
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Free Zone Authorities ang may responsibilidad na i-monitor ang galaw ng Goods sa loob ng Free Zone kung saan ito ina-admit, at magbibigay sila ng copies ng report sa Bureau para ma-monitor ang location ng admitted Goods.

paragraphs.text: From One Free Zone to another Free Zone. Transfer of Goods from one Free Zone into another Free Zone shall be covered by the necessary Transit Permit which shall be accepted by the Bureau and Free Zone Authorities as Goods Declaration for Transit and Admission, whenever appropriate, under such guidelines issued and prescribed jointly by Bureau and the Free Zone Authorities.

ai.title: Zone-to-Zone Transfer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang paglipat ng Goods mula isang Free Zone papunta sa iba ay covered ng necessary Transit Permit, na tatanggapin ng Bureau at Free Zone Authorities bilang Goods Declaration for Transit and Admission, ayon sa guidelines na magkasamang inilabas ng Bureau at Free Zone Authorities.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal of Goods from Free Zones for Consumption in the Customs Territory.

ai.title: Withdrawal for Consumption
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ng rules sa paglabas ng Goods mula Free Zone para sa consumption sa Customs Territory (Secs. 4.4.1 hanggang 4.4.4).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'labas ng zone' — dito nagsisimula ang duty at tax.

paragraphs.text: Imported Goods directly admitted into Free Zones then subsequently withdrawn for Entry into a Customs Territory shall be covered by a Goods Declaration for Consumption. This shall be lodged with the Bureau together with the copy of previously lodged Goods Declaration for Admission and other required documents pursuant to existing laws and regulations.

ai.title: Declaration for Consumption sa Withdrawal
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang imported Goods na direktang ina-admit sa Free Zone at kalaunan ay withdrawn for Entry sa Customs Territory ay covered ng Goods Declaration for Consumption, na lo-lodge sa Bureau kasama ang copy ng naunang Goods Declaration for Admission at iba pang required documents.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Paglabas ng zone: bagong declaration (for Consumption) at ilalakip ang lumang Declaration for Admission.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Huwag kalimutang ilakip ang copy ng previously lodged Goods Declaration for Admission. Batayan: Sec. 814 ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.4.1 ng CAO No. 11-2019 tungkol sa Declaration for Consumption sa Withdrawal. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Imported Goods, whether in their original or advanced form, shall be withdrawn from the Free Zone for Entry to the Customs Territory when the Goods Declaration is lodged with the corresponding permit issued by the Free Zone Authority and upon posting of sufficient security as applicable, in accordance with systems, rules and regulations jointly issued and prescribed by the Bureau and the Free Zone Authorities. Withdrawal of Goods from the Free Zone into the Customs Territory shall be covered by the necessary Goods Declaration for Consumption.

ai.title: Permit at Security sa Withdrawal
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang imported Goods, original man o advanced form, ay withdrawn from the Free Zone for Entry kapag na-lodge ang Goods Declaration kasama ang corresponding permit ng Free Zone Authority at pagkatapos mag-post ng sufficient security (kung applicable), ayon sa systems at rules na magkasamang inilabas ng Bureau at Free Zone Authorities.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tatlong kailangan: Goods Declaration, permit mula sa Free Zone Authority, at security kung applicable.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Goods Declaration for Consumption pa rin ang sasaklaw sa withdrawal.

paragraphs.text: In case of withdrawal of imported Goods from Free Zones for introduction to the Customs Territory, the duty rate and exchange rate at the time of withdrawal shall be applicable on the Goods originally admitted, whether withdrawn in its original or advanced form.

ai.title: Duty Rate at Exchange Rate sa Withdrawal
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa withdrawal ng imported Goods mula Free Zones papunta Customs Territory, ang duty rate at exchange rate sa oras ng withdrawal ang ia-apply sa Goods na orihinal na ina-admit, original man o advanced form.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi ang rate noong pumasok ang goods, kundi ang rate noong lumabas.

paragraphs.text: Except in cases prescribed by existing laws, all applicable duties, taxes and other charges on Goods introduced into the Customs Territory from the Free Zones shall be paid to the Bureau before release from custody subject to the prior requirement of Authority to Release Imported Goods (ATRIG) for certain Goods.

paragraphs.text: In case of sale or auction of Goods by a Free Zone enterprise or locator to a buyer from the Customs Territory (i.e. domestic sales), all Value-Added Tax (VAT) due, if any, on Goods sold or auctioned shall be payable to the Bureau of Customs (i.e., VAT due and collected on the imported Goods paid by the locator plus the VAT due on the actual selling or winning bid price of the Goods sold or auctioned, respectively, less the input VAT, if any).

ai.title: VAT sa Domestic Sales
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag nagbenta o nag-auction ang Free Zone enterprise o locator ng Goods sa buyer mula Customs Territory (domestic sales), ang VAT due, kung mayroon, ay babayaran sa Bureau of Customs: VAT sa imported Goods na binayaran ng locator plus ang VAT sa aktwal na selling o winning bid price, less ang input VAT kung mayroon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa domestic sale, BOC ang kumokolekta ng VAT. Computation: VAT sa import + VAT sa benta o winning bid − input VAT.

paragraphs.text: The Admission, Transit, withdrawal and export of Goods from the Free Zone shall be governed by the rules and regulations jointly issued by the Bureau and the Free Zone Authorities. paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall coordinate with Free Zone Authorities to establish a BOC-Free Zone inter-operability system, by making full use of Information and Communications Technology (ICT).

paragraphs.text: Requirement to Keep Importation Records.

paragraphs.text: Locators and Port Users are subject to the post-clearance audit function of the Bureau. paragraphs.text: Free Zones Monitoring Office. The Bureau shall establish an office to monitor and coordinate with Free Zones Authorities for the Admission, Transit, withdrawal or any movement of Goods to and from the Free Zones.

paragraphs.text: To ensure compliance with customs laws and regulations, this CAO shall be reviewed every three (3) years and be amended or revised, if necessary, by the Bureau in coordination with the Free Zone Authorities.

paragraphs.text: If any part of this CAO is declared by Courts as unconstitutional or contrary to existing laws, the other parts not so declared shall remain in full force and effect.

paragraphs.text: Pending the issuance of a Joint Administrative Order between the Bureau of Customs and Free Zone Authorities, the existing clearance procedure relative to Admission and Transit being adopted by the Free Zone Authorities and the Bureau shall apply respectively.
